description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper class and related factory functions for GStreamer utilities within the Rialto server project. It includes method definitions for performing audio track codec channel switching, utilizing external GStreamer utilities.

classes.description: Factory interface for creating RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper instances.

classes.name: RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class providing GStreamer utility functions, including performAudioTrackCodecChannelSwitch.

methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the factory for RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper.

methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper.

methods.name: performAudioTrackCodecChannelSwitch
methods.description: Performs a switch of the audio track codec channel, utilizing underlying GStreamer utilities.
